executedChecks.scope: Focused module run, Python 3.13.11 on macOS 27.0.1; the darwin-only real sandbox-exec compile test ran (not skipped); three repeated runs all OK.

Design-time experiments in a scratch directory as the developer account with the pinned Python interpreter as target, not with claude and not as qualification evidence: deny-default plus narrowed system reads runs the interpreter; dyld aborts (134) unless file-read-data on / is allowed; the narrowed /System subpaths suffice; without a sysctl rule sysctl reads are denied; remote tcp localhost:PORT admits 127.0.0.1 and ::1 on that port, denies other loopback ports, public IPs and UDP; /System/Volumes/Data reads are denied while params under /private/var stay writable; sandbox-exec exits 65 on a profile compile error and 71 on a denied exec; setrlimit(RLIMIT_AS) to 4 GiB is refused on macOS 27.0.1.

executedChecks.scope: Run by Claude subagents (not independent review). Applied: kill/settle/sweep in a finally on every exit path with fixed reasons (supervisor-failed, workspace-unavailable, launch-failed) and evidence; fail-closed process accounting (process-accounting-failed) with ctypes signatures, truncation retry and (pid, start time) identities; out-of-band preamble failure pipe instead of exit 125; sysctl-read removed; /System narrowed with an explicit /System/Volumes/Data deny; remote tcp and a ::1 listener; flock against concurrent runs (dedicated-user-busy); executable ancestor write check; candidate must be a private direct child of run_root; write roots disjoint from the interpreter root, minimum interpreter-root depth; component hashes of harness_lab and harness_host_claude and the supervisor interpreter in the environment hash; ECH refusal, handshake deadline and tunnel bound in the proxy; run_probe and invalid-launch refusals recorded; mechanism checks before the candidate check; HostRun replaces a private result type; split policy checks, helper extraction and test simplifications.

negativeControls.OS build or CLI version outside window: os-unsupported for 27.1, 26.4.1, malformed build or product; cli-version-unsupported for any pinned version other than 2.1.292; executable-drift or executable-unavailable for a changed, symlinked or swappable executable

negativeControls.mechanism absent: mechanism-unavailable (not darwin, missing binary, not root-owned, group/other writable)
negativeControls.policy render/compile failure: invalid-policy at construction; profile-compile-failed on sandbox-exec exit 65, timeout or workspace error; self-check-allowed when the unlisted exec is not denied
negativeControls.qualification for another backend or env: qualification-backend-mismatch, qualification-environment-mismatch, host-mismatch, qualification-drift at construction; environment-drift and qualification-expired before every run

openForProbesAndFounder: NC-5 says the dedicated user's own keychain; the profile denies every mach-lookup, so keychain services are unreachable. Either the login works from CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR alone or an enumerated mach-lookup set must be decided after CRED probes; fails closed until then.
The root directory entry / is readable (listing), required by dyld; recorded residual.
Pinned executables must sit below directories no other account can write; the Homebrew Cellar and Caskroom are group-writable (admin), so the qualified install location is an operator setup step.

Claude helpers, OAuth refresh endpoints, sysctl or mach needs, and which CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR paths are session state (to be purged between runs, NC-7) are probe-observed and need a new decision record before they enter the policy.
The probe runner is trusted T007 code; binding it to probe_catalog_sha256 is the runner's job.

Residual risks: same-UID supervisor and child (a sandbox escape compromises the supervisor and proxy); deprecated sandbox-exec semantics; memory watchdog sampling window and resident-size accounting; no total disk quota beyond per-file size; exfiltration through the allowed API host; pid races in the sweep.
outcome: New agent_braid/harness_containment_macos.py: MacOSContainment (kind native, backend id macos-dedicated-user-sandbox-exec) implements ContainmentBackend with a fixture entry point run, a T007 probe entry point run_probe and a contained launcher launch for T006, all built from one ContainmentPolicy. The policy renders a deterministic deny-default SBPL profile per entry (exec allow-list; reads limited to pinned executables, narrowed system library paths and the root directory entry dyld opens; metadata only on ancestors; writes only in the CANDIDATE and TMPDIR params plus the dedicated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for launch; explicit deny of /System/Volumes/Data; network only TCP to the loopback proxy port; no sysctl, mach-lookup, ipc or inbound rules), a child environment built from scratch, the NC-8 rlimits and an environment hash over every native-profile.md input (OS product/build/arch, mechanism path and hash, account and uid, both profile hashes, Claude path/hash/version, helpers, interpreter, supervisor interpreter, credential method, config dir, run root, endpoints, proxy port, enforcing component hashes, limits, probe catalog hash). EgressProxy holds the port on 127.0.0.1 and ::1 and admits CONNECT only to api.anthropic.com:443 (plus probe-observed refresh endpoints) when the single TLS SNI equals the CONNECT host, refusing ECH hellos, with a handshake deadline and a tunnel wall bound. Before every run the backend takes an exclusive flock on run_root, verifies both trusted records (backend id, shared environment, expiry), the OS window 27.0.x, ENV_DENY absence, the dedicated account (uid equals the supervisor's), sandbox-exec ownership and pinned hash, pinned executables (regular, not symlinked, no group/other write on the file or any ancestor), workspace ownership and modes, the recomputed environment hash, a private candidate directly below run_root, a real sandbox-exec compile check that must report the exec of /usr/bin/false as denied, and the NC-11 subset FS-01, NET-01, CRED-01, PROC-01, NET-06 through the injected probe runner. Supervision applies RLIMIT_CPU, FSIZE, CORE, NOFILE and NPROC (baseline + 1 + 16) in a preamble that reports failure over a close-on-exec pipe, watches wall, cancel, output and memory (resident bytes of new dedicated-user processes, since macOS 27 refuses RLIMIT_AS below the current address space), and always kills, settles the group and sweeps new dedicated-user processes keyed by (pid, start time); an escape leaves the run unsettled. Every refusal and every run is appended to run_evidence with the qualification hashes and check results.
